items.title: Interview on Andrey Pronin's Channel
items.description: Andrey Pronin runs an outsourcing company and hosts public developer interviews on his YouTube channel. One hour to build a DRF project from scratch — live on camera. I participated alongside Daulet — we pulled it off.

items.title: Interview on Evgeny Bartenev's Channel
items.description: Evgeny is a Yandex Practicum tech lead with more than 20 years of experience in IT. In the interview, I confidently answer questions, show how I think, how I solve problems — and even when I make mistakes, it becomes a great opportunity for a valuable discussion. The mock interview turned out to be lively, honest, and useful.
